verdict.rationale: Flagsmith's docs describe end-to-end A/B testing. Multivariate flags serve A/B/n variants with percentage weightings, events are collected into a managed data warehouse, and a built-in Bayesian statistics engine reports the results. The GitHub README also lists A/B and multivariate testing. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of how metrics are defined and how a winning variant is declared, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the experimentation results workflow.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can run A/B and multivariate experiments on flags and see which variation wins on my metrics

citations.quote: Flagsmith Experimentation lets you run A/B tests end to end on the platform: serve variations of a feature with a multivariate flag, collect events from your application into a managed data warehouse, and read the results with a built-in Bayesian statistics engine.
Multivariate flags let you define multiple variants with percentage weightings (A/B/n).
A/B testing: Use segments to run A/B and multivariate tests on new features
